Itemized Passive Description:
*Basic effect(s)*
- ATK & DEF 250%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Launches an additional attack
- Great chance of evading enemy's attack
*When attacking*
- DEF 100%{passiveImg:up_g}
*For every attack performed*
- {passiveImg:forever}ATK & DEF 30%{passiveImg:up_g} (up to 200%)
*If HP is 85% or more when attacking, or if the target enemy
is in the following status: {passiveImg:atk_down} or {passiveImg:def_down}*
- Launches an additional attack that has a high chance of
becoming a Super Attack
- High chance of performing a critical hit
- {passiveImg:forever}ATK & DEF 50%{passiveImg:up_g} for every attack performed
(up to 300%)
*After evading 3 or more attacks in battle*
- {passiveImg:forever}Launches an additional attack that has a high chance
of becoming a Super Attack
*As the 3rd attacker in a turn*
- Launches an additional attack that has a high chance of
becoming a Super Attack
- "Majin Buu Saga" Category allies' Ki +1 and ATK & DEF 20%{passiveImg:up_g},
plus an additional Ki +2 and ATK & DEF 30%{passiveImg:up_g} for characters
who are also Extreme Class, for 3 turns
*When 4 or more "Majin Buu Saga" Category allies are on the team,
or when all allies are Extreme Class characters*
- Chance of evading enemy's attack 15%{passiveImg:up_g} when attacking
- {passiveImg:once}Evades enemy's attack within the turn when the
character is the 1st attacker at the start of turn
